title: Midnight @ Pian delle more (Sassetta, Italy)
creator: ciapistess
attribution: Midnight @ Pian delle more (Sassetta, Italy), ciapistess, via Internet Archive, Public Domain Mark 1.0
notes: Steadiest night cricket bed of the set. Item description: crickets, birds, dogs, handheld Tascam DR-05 with some handling noise. Very quiet (-43.9 LUFS), needs about +20 dB and a high-pass at 120 Hz. No wind to speak of; add wind in WebAudio. Loop needs a crossfade of 4 s or more.

title: Crickets over Vaclavice (Cvrcci nad Vaclavicemi)
creator: Milos Vojtechovsky
attribution: Crickets over Vaclavice (Cvrcci nad Vaclavicemi), Milos Vojtechovsky, via Internet Archive, Public Domain Mark 1.0
notes: Meadow crickets, 128.5 s, loud and clean (-31.4 LUFS) but the file is an edit ("poeticaedit") with cuts and gated gaps, so not seamless; use the longest continuous stretch. Recorded 16:39, so insects only, no night birds.

title: Crickets in the Bushes (Colchester, UK)
creator: philipmill6 (as published)
attribution: Crickets in the Bushes (Colchester, UK), philipmill6 (as published), via Internet Archive, Public Domain Mark 1.0
notes: 240 s of crickets, longest bed. Two loud car passes at about 2:50 and 3:35 (visible in spectrogram), so use the first 165 s. Description says crickets and cars.
